title: Partial-quote stubs from Telegram reply quotes
description: message.quote -> transclusions[].selector {exact,prefix,suffix} per 0.3 revision (decision #49).

title: Warn when a handwritten changelog note repeats removed words (§5.2)
description: Handwritten notes (/note, reply to 'held vN', /publish <note>, /republish <note>) skip reproducesRemoved; only Haiku's are checked. Warn the owner, don't block.

title: Fragment cap: long messages become threads
description: Spec recommends 2000-char fragments.

title: Read 0.4 manifest-located surface: expand item/pin templates instead of items/{id}.json
description: §6.1/§12: readers MUST expand manifest item {id} and pin {id},{n} templates. fetchItem, mentions targetPage, backfill-snapshots, refresh-sub, quoteLinks fallback all hardcode items/{id}.json. Store templates per subscription.

title: Drafts from other clients, published from Pub
description: Authenticated POST /api/drafts lets another client (an agent, a script) submit a draft. The bot previews it in Pub; the owner replies /publish or /discard, so Telegram stays the point of publish. Drafts are invisible to the protocol (§5.2, §9). A draft may declare itself generated: the published item carries generated[] and the body is wrapped in div.blyg-tk-gen (§5.7).

title: Edit in Pub topic -> new version
description: edited_message -> versions row v(n+1), items updated. Same-text edits are no-ops. Reply with new version link.

title: Remote generation sources in drafts + source mentions
description: §5.7/§15.4 (0.4): generated.sources may carry origin (+cited), resolved from snapshots like a directive; SHOULD send a mention with relation source.

title: Surface Sub-side edits: reply after a 1h window, coalesce replies
description: New version of a followed item: always edit the original Sub message. If the original was posted <1h ago, stop there. Otherwise reply to it with full new content + link; if the bot's last update reply for that item is <1h old, edit that reply instead. Withdrawals outside the window: blank the original and reply 'title · withdrawn'. Needs posted_at, reply_message_id, replied_at on imported.

title: Drop held edits when a post is withdrawn
description: withdraw() leaves held_edits rows in state held. Harmless (publishHeld drops stale holds) but tidier to mark them dropped on withdraw.

title: Sub groupings: multiple Sub topics as feed folders
description: Each registered Sub topic is a grouping with its own follows. Feeds are fetched once per poll and fanned out to every following topic. Pub groupings (topic -> blyg slug) come after L1/L2 lands; keep the schema open for them.

title: Schema: split subscriptions into feeds + follows + sub_topics; key imported by topic
description: feeds(origin, index_url, index_etag, created, last_polled, next_poll, failures, last_error); sub_topics(topic_id, name, created); follows(topic_id, origin); imported PK (topic_id, origin, item_id) with tg_message_id, posted_at, reply_message_id, replied_at. Migration seeds SUB_TOPIC_ID as the first sub_topic and moves existing rows. Don't touch items/versions (L1/L2 agent).

title: Polling fans out each feed to every following Sub topic
description: pollOne fetches index + changed items once per feed, then present() per follow with that topic's watermark. Fetch budget counts feeds, not follows. Cron sends Sub per topic, not a single topicId.

title: Sub commands work in any registered Sub topic, scoped to it
description: /subscribe, /unsubscribe, /subscriptions act on the topic they're sent in. /subscriptions in the original Sub topic lists everything with grouping labels. Unsubscribing the last follow of a feed deletes the feed.

title: Create/adopt Sub groupings: /newsub <name> and /sub <name>
description: /newsub creates a forum topic via createForumTopic (bot needs manage-topics) and registers it. /sub <name> inside an existing topic adopts it. Optional: editForumTopic for rename, icon_custom_emoji_id per grouping.

title: /withdraw (reply to a published message) -> withdrawal endcap
description: Telegram does not report deletions, so withdrawal is explicit. Endcap per spec §9; feed drops prior entries for that item.

title: Auto changelog notes for edits from Pub
description: vgr strong norm (4dkqht955z9aq1ekr7bekex980): cheap model writes a changelog note (generated: true) on every edit; empty changelogs read as low quality.

title: Sub topic: /follow and 15-minute cron polling
description: Admin topic /follow /unfollow /following. Spec §12 resolution, conditional GETs, archive index reconciliation, watermark + content_hash checks. Post new items/versions into Sub topic; edit our message on new versions.

title: Pin in Pub topic -> blyg pin
description: pinned_message service message -> pin current version, serve items/{id}/v{n}.json. Pins are irrevocable: unpin in Telegram is ignored with a notice.

title: Configurable poll interval in admin
description: Subscriptions poll on a fixed 15-minute cron. Make the interval configurable (per blyg or globally) from an admin surface; respect §12.3 politeness and backoff. Also consider showing last successful check in /subscriptions so quiet authors don't look like a broken poller.

title: Sub: reply links to stub a followed post
description: Show a reply/stub link at the bottom of each Sub message. Consider how it interacts with threads (stubs are threads, blyxt-qs2.1) and the existing stub issues blyxt-dxn / blyxt-0fi.

title: Labels: [[id | text]] links and ![[id | note]] directives
description: §10.1 (0.4, #70): label after pipe; link label is anchor text, directive label is an author comment that never reaches the bake. Also normalize CRLF (#76).

title: Shared links -> stubs (L2)
description: Blyg item links pasted first in Pub already stub (blyxt-fc9). Remaining: plain-web URLs -> {url} stub_of with cited, ordinary Webmention to the URL, and the iOS share-sheet flow (link + comment as two messages).

title: Phone smoke test of held notes after deploy
description: After held-notes ships: edit a Pub post, reply to 'held vN' with a note, confirm v(N) publishes with it; /note path too.

title: Stub followed posts by quoting them in Pub
description: In Pub, a thread that opens with a quote of a post is a stub of it (§10.6): reply in Pub to a Sub message (cross-topic reply), paste a followed post's link first, or write ![[id]]. Remote quotes bake from stored, sanitized snapshots (§10.2); stub_of carries cited; remote references send Webmentions (§15.2) with retry from cron. No command needed.

title: Deploy: Cloudflare account, D1, secrets, webhook, Vercel rewrite in motherbase
description: README Deploy steps 1-5. Needs Cloudflare account. motherbase: add vercel.json rewrite /blyg/:path* -> worker; retire scripts/blyg.ts and public/blyg.
notes: Worker live at https://blyxt.blyxt.workers.dev, D1 migrated, secrets set, webhook set. Remaining: motherbase vercel.json rewrite, retire old static blyg.

title: Legacy RSS (L0) subscriptions
description: Spec 13.6: wrap plain RSS entries as summary + link with synthetic ids. /subscribe currently replies that legacy feeds aren't supported.

title: Declare blyg 0.4 in manifest, items and feed
description: After the 0.4 MUSTs land (templates, labels).

title: AI chat over pub/sub history in Admin topic
description: Query Pub and Sub history conversationally.

title: Publish new posts over 1,024 characters as threads
links[]: disclose [[id]] links and send link mentions
description: §10.3a (#79): items carry links [{id, origin?}] in document order; remote entries send a link mention (notice). Remote link hrefs use snapshot page or item document, never t/ or f/ (#85).

title: Generated notes: strip possessive 's before the removed-word check
description: §5.2: words() tokenizes "Bob's" as bob's, so a note saying "Bob" passes when Bob's was removed. Strip a trailing 's / ’s in words().

title: L1 catch-up: publish-side features and reader SHOULDs
description: Finish what L1 describes before L2 (stubs are threads; pinned quotes survive withdrawal). Wire MUSTs fixed in 0a106ad: absolute content_html urls, [[id]] links, directive lines refused until threads exist.

title: Threads with same-origin transclusion: reply in Pub to your own post
description: Reply in Pub to a published message -> thread whose body starts with ![[id]] of the replied item. Also accept ![[id]] lines typed directly (compose currently refuses them). kind thread, per-version transclusions[] (no origin for own-origin), bake <blockquote class="blyg-transclusion" data-blyg-id data-blyg-version>, closure check, t/{id}/ pages, partial quotes via Telegram reply quote (selector). Groundwork for L2 stubs.

title: Reader: surface watermark regressions and stop the refetch loop
description: §13.3: a fetched version below the watermark is skipped (correct) but never surfaced, and leaves index_etag null so it refetches every poll forever. Record the discrepancy once (Sub notice or last_error) and stop refetching until the index changes.

title: Reader: verify content_hash and detect stealth edits
description: §13.3 SHOULDs: check sha256(content_md) on import; same version with a different hash is a stealth edit (adopt content, surface it). Needs periodic item refetch, since only version bumps trigger fetches today.

title: Reader: fall back to the feed when items/index.json is missing
description: §13.2: a 404 index is a nonconforming publisher; SHOULD fall back to feed-window-only and mark the subscription lossy. /subscribe currently refuses.

title: Don't resurface same-hash republishes in Sub
description: §13.2 (#77): a version whose content_hash equals the previous one is maintenance; SHOULD NOT resurface. present() sends a fresh reply when the Sub message is stale.

title: Receive Webmentions -> Responses in Sub topic
description: Spec §15 endpoint: rate limits, async structural verification, never auto-published.

title: Web home: masthead, pages, /file collections, pace-layered home, blogroll
Require changelog notes: Haiku with a key, else hold edits until the owner writes one
description: Workers AI model @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct was retired, so auto notes silently failed. Replace with optional ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (Haiku); without it, edits are held (vgr #83 held revisions) until a note arrives by reply or /note; /republish and revision /publish take the note inline.
